voices.note: the Rabbis disputing R' Natan over the thrown knife (31b.18-19, 31b.22)
immersion in edges, not arcs, cited 31b.4
produce fallen into a water channel, cited 31b.5-6
immersed for chullin and assumed its status, cited 31b.7 and 31b.9
R' Yonatan ben Yosef's baraita on 'washed a second time' (31b.13-14)
deaf / imbecile / blind / deranged women prepared by competent women, cited 31b.21
anonymous Gemara voice of this sugya

props.gloss_en: a niddah who was forced and immersed -- she is pure for her house
...and forbidden to eat teruma
R' Yochanan: she is not pure even for her house
her husband is chullin
and chullin does not require intent
a wave that was detached with forty se'a in it and fell on a person and on vessels -- they are pure
perhaps we are dealing with one who sits and waits for when the wave will be detached; and vessels are like a person -- a person intends for them
lest you say: decree [against the wave] because of a cascade of rain -- it teaches that we do not decree
or: decree the edges because of the arcs -- it teaches that we do not decree
we do not immerse in the arcs [of waves]
one immerses in the edges and does not immerse in the arcs, for one does not immerse in the air
produce fell into a water channel, and one whose hands were impure stretched out and took it -- his hands are pure, and the produce is not in 'ki yutan'
and the produce is not in 'ki yutan'
and if [he did it] so that his hands would be rinsed -- [his hands are] pure, and the produce is in 'ki yutan'
one immersed for chullin and assumed [purity-]status for chullin -- forbidden for maaser
Rava: [only if] he assumed the status, yes; if he did not assume it, no
this is what it says: even though he assumed the status for chullin, he is forbidden for maaser
one immersed and did not assume the status -- as if he had not immersed
Rava: does it not mean as if he had not immersed at all?
no: as if he had not immersed for maaser, but he did immerse for chullin
one immersed and did not assume the status -- permitted for chullin and forbidden for maaser
Rav Yosef: R' Yochanan says [his view] according to R' Yonatan ben Yosef
R' Yonatan ben Yosef: as the first washing is with intent, so the second washing is with intent
[entertained:] if so -- as there the priest's intent is required, here too the priest's intent is required?
the verse says 'and it shall be pure' -- in any case [not requiring the priest's intent]
but R' Yochanan said: the halakha follows an unattributed mishna
[recalled:] we learned 'a knife fell and slaughtered ... invalid', inferred 'had he dropped it -- valid though he did not intend', and asked who the tanna is; Rava: it is R' Natan
in slaughter even R' Yonatan ben Yosef concedes: for chullin we do not require intent
since the Merciful One revealed that one acting unawares in sacrifices -- invalid
and the Rabbis: granted we do not require intent for slaughtering, for cutting we do require [it]

is it written 'and you shall cut'? 'and you shall slaughter' is written: if intent is required for cutting, it should be required for slaughtering too; if it is not required for slaughtering, it should not be required for cutting either
[entertained:] if we say that her friend forced her and immersed her
her friend's intent is full-fledged intent
and moreover, she would eat teruma too
the deaf woman, the imbecile, the blind woman and one whose mind was deranged -- if they have competent women who prepare them, they eat teruma
Rav Pappa: according to R' Natan -- where she fell from a bridge
and according to the Rabbis -- where she went down to cool off

schemas.gloss_en: עון כרת התרת, איסור מיתה מיבעיא? -- forced immersion released her from a karet prohibition (her husband); a prohibition carrying death (teruma) should surely be released

grounds.gloss_en: Rav Nachman: בעלה חולין הוא, וחולין לא בעי כוונה -- the source differs: her husband is chullin, and chullin needs no intent (= p_baalah_chullin, p_chullin_lo_baei_kavana)

schemas.gloss_en: וכבס שנית -- מה תלמוד לומר שנית? מקיש תכבוסת שניה לתכבוסת ראשונה: as the first washing is with intent, so the second

supports.gloss_en: ומנא תימרא? דתנן: גל שנתלש ... טהורין; מאי לאו אדם דומיא דכלים -- as vessels have no intent, a person needs none (kind svara under protest: the marker is דתנן)

deflected_by.gloss_en: ממאי? דלמא ביושב ומצפה אימתי יתלש הגל, וכלים דומיא דאדם (= p_okimta_yoshev_umetzapeh); defended against מאי למימרא at 31b.2-3 (see necessities) -- a deflection cannot be defended in the schema

supports.gloss_en: ומנא תימרא דלא מטבלינן בכיפין? דתנן: מטבילין בראשין ואין מטבילין בכיפין, שאין מטבילין באויר (kind svara under protest: the marker is דתנן)
אלא חולין דלא בעי כוונה מיהא מנלן? דתנן: פירות שנפלו לתוך אמת המים ... ידיו טהורות -- his hands are purified though he did not intend it (kind svara under protest: the marker is דתנן)
נפק דק ואשכח, דתניא: טבל ולא הוחזק -- מותר לחולין ואסור למעשר (kind svara under protest: the marker is נפק דק ואשכח דתניא)
דתניא: רבי יונתן בן יוסף אומר ... אף תכבוסת שניה לדעת (kind svara: no support kind for a bare דתניא)
מדגלי רחמנא מתעסק בקדשים פסול -- מכלל דחולין לא בעינן כוונה
דתנן: החרשת והשוטה ... אם יש להן פקחות מתקנות אותן -- אוכלות בתרומה (kind svara under protest: the marker is דתנן)

challenges.gloss_en: לימא תיהוי תיובתא דרבי יוחנן מהא -- from the baraita just found (p_baraita_mutar_lachullin: immersed without assuming status, permitted for chullin), R' Yochanan's 'not pure even for her house' would be refuted

answered_by.gloss_en: רבי יוחנן הוא דאמר כרבי יונתן בן יוסף (= p_ry_kerabbi_yonatan_ben_yosef)

objections.gloss_en: איתיביה: טבל לחולין והוחזק לחולין -- אסור למעשר; הוחזק אין, לא הוחזק לא (= p_rava_huchzak_in) -- so immersion for chullin does need intent

answered_by.gloss_en: הכי קאמר: אף על פי שהוחזק לחולין -- אסור למעשר (= p_rn_af_al_pi_shehuchzak)

objections.gloss_en: איתיביה: טבל ולא הוחזק -- כאילו לא טבל; מאי לאו כאילו לא טבל כלל (= p_rava_keilu_lo_tavel_klal)

answered_by.gloss_en: לא, כאילו לא טבל למעשר, אבל טבל לחולין (= p_rn_keilu_lo_tavel_lemaaser); הוא סבר דחויי קא מדחי ליה -- Rava thought this was a mere putting-off

objections.gloss_en: ומי אמר רבי יוחנן הכי? והאמר רבי יוחנן הלכה כסתם משנה (= p_ry_halakha_kistam_mishna_31b), ותנן נפלה סכין ... -- and Rava: it is R' Natan, who requires no intent

answered_by.gloss_en: בשחיטה, אפילו רבי יונתן בן יוסף מודי (= p_shechitat_chullin_lo_baei_kavana) -- so R' Yochanan can follow both the stam mishna and R' Yonatan ben Yosef

objections.gloss_en: מי כתיב וחתכת? וזבחת כתיב -- cutting and slaughtering cannot differ in their need for intent (reported by Rava: בהא זכנהו רבי נתן לרבנן)
